children: Construction Partners completed acquisition of Roads, Inc., adding a hot‑mix asphalt plant and more than 150 employees to expand Florida Panhandle operations.
Acquired Roads, Inc., an asphalt manufacturing and construction business headquartered in Cantonment, Florida.
Purchase includes a strategically located hot‑mix asphalt plant north of Pensacola plus related crews and equipment.
Acquired operations will be integrated into CPI’s Florida platform company, C.W. Roberts Contracting.
Transaction brings over 150 employees, enhancing service capacity across the Florida Panhandle and surrounding region.
